{
 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-hermes-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u084/system/state/workspace/programs/task-4e2a6d5e.py",
 "content": "from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

    # The full-width stripe is the barrier.
    barrier_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(g)
                    if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != bg]
    if not barrier_rows:
        return g
    br = barrier_rows[0]
    barrier_color = g[br][0]

    # The movable figure is the non-background, non-barrier-color content.
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
              if g[r][c] != bg and g[r][c] != barrier_color]
    if not points:
        return g
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, _ in points), max(r for r, _ in points)
    c0, c1 = min(c for _, c in points), max(c for _, c in points)
    figure = [(r-r0, c-c0, g[r][c]) for r, c in points]
    fh = r1-r0+1

    # Move the figure against the barrier and add a color-8 stripe on its far side.
    if r0 > br:
        new_r0 = br + 1
        new_line = new_r0 + fh
    else:
        new_r0 = br - fh
        new_line = new_r0 - 1

    for r, c in points:
        g[r][c] = bg
    for dr, dc, color in figure:
        rr, cc = new_r0 + dr, c0 + dc
        if 0 <= rr < h:
            g[rr][cc] = color
    if 0 <= new_line < h:
        g[new_line] = [8] * w
    return g


if __name__ == '__main__':
    test = [[1]*27 for _ in range(9)]
    test[1][16:21] = [3]*5
    test[4] = [2]*27
    out = transform(test)
    assert out[2] == [8]*27
    assert out[3][16:21] == [3]*5 and out[3][:16] == [1]*16
    assert out[4] == [2]*27
    assert sum(v == 3 for row in out for v in row) == 5
    print(out)
    # Demonstration structure: 3x6 figure with two background-colored holes.
    demo = [[0]*16 for _ in range(29)]
    demo[9] = [2]*16
    demo[23][9:15] = [1]*6
    demo[24][9:15] = [1]*6
    demo[25][9:15] = [1,1,0,0,1,1]
    demo_out = transform(demo)
    assert demo_out[9] == [2]*16
    assert demo_out[10][9:15] == [1]*6
    assert demo_out[11][9:15] == [1]*6
    assert demo_out[12][9:15] == [1,1,0,0,1,1]
    assert demo_out[13] == [8]*16
    print('demo structure checks passed')
    print('test output rows:', out)
